text: Three replicas of one database: separate processes, ports and files. Each is a full copy, and any of them can sync with any other.
Alice creates a note on A.
B syncs with A. The note arrives on B.
C syncs with B. Bob's edit arrives on C.
A syncs with C, then B syncs with C. All three have Carol's version, and there is no conflict: each edit was made after seeing the one before.

text: B syncs again. All three replicas show the same conflict and the same version, chosen independently by the same rules, with no coordinator.
